plan.english: The wolf saw the sheep in the field.
The sheep was trembling, and the shepherd was guarding her.
Shepherd, guard the sheep from the wolf!
The dog heard the wolf's voice.
The old horse was carrying the load to the river.
Bird, do not fear the snake!
The bear sat down at the oak.
Who has seen my ram?
The forsaken pig was lying in the enclosure.
The he-goat was licking the stone.
Let us drink the river's water!
The snake was creeping toward the bird.
The fire was burning, and the sheep trembled in fear.
The she-wolf slays the shepherd's ram.
May the shepherd's dogs be alert!
The thief was driving the horses from the field.
Now the cook is cooking the liver.
The bird sat down in the birch and kept looking at the wolf.
The water is boiling on the fire.
Which dog protects the sheep?
The horse drank the water and was standing in the river.
Wolf, do not seize my sheep!
The shepherd is milking the old sheep.
The bear is thirsty and is going to the river.
The fire is devouring the dry tree.
May the wolves not find the sheep!
The dog was following the thief.
The ram wears wool.
The shepherd was scraping the wool with a comb.
In the winter the river became stone.
The water snake was swimming in the river.
Horse, swim in the river!
The bird recognized the snake, and it is afraid.
Who is crawling in the field?
The shepherd is putting the stone in the enclosure.
The goat was urinating on the cook's head.
The wolf was eating the leftover liver.
Now the water is getting dark, and the sheep are lying down.
Let us lead the horses to the water!
The yoked horses were transporting the loads.
The bear was lifting the stone with its strength.
May the field be productive!
The shepherd is pleased, and the sheep are satisfied.
Who split the oak?
The thief is hiding the loot in the tree.
Dog, listen to the shepherd!
The sheep were listening to the shepherd's song.
Be awake, shepherd! The wolves are coming to your sheep.
One sheep was walking in the middle field.
The shepherd was hitting the snake's head with a stone.
One daughter has been born to the king.
The father of the king was a god.
The god's daughter became queen.
The man's son has been born in the household.
The mother's brother lived in the king's household.
The son-in-law of the clan chief became king.
The orphan did not know his father.
The king's sister was leading the people.
The god's eye was watching the people.
The people know the name of the god.
In the third year the king's son became lord.
The old father-in-law gave a gift to the son-in-law.
The husband's brother lived in the father's household.
The king's son is healthy, and he is grown.
The orphan was barefoot, and the other one was healthy.
The clan chief's mother was the daughter of a king.
The god seated the son in the father's household.
One of the brothers was striking down the other.
The queen nourished the orphan.
The virile man carried the old father on his shoulder.
The king's daughter-in-law is born of the gods.
In the spring the son arrived home.
The father's name lives in the son.
The master of the household maintains the people.
The sons of mortals trust the gods.
Now darkness is coming. Guest, sit down in my house!
Who are you, guest?
I am the son of the king.
Mother, give me the bowl!
Which name did the father give to the son?
Brother, let us go to the village!
Do not be afraid, sister; the god protects us.
May the gods give you a son!
Whom are you seeking, guest?
I am seeking out the master of the household.
Woman, who is your father?
Now you, people, hear the voice of the king!
Son, lift the yoke!
I am satisfied, lord.
Let us eat, and let us drink!
Daughter, who gave you this gift?
My mother handed it to me.
King, let us give a poured gift to the gods!
Do not kill the guest, brother-in-law!
Woman, I do not see my son.
Your son is walking on the path.
Stand up, man, and go home!
May the goddess hear our voice!
I believe you, father-in-law.
Cook, heat the egg!
The giver shall give the bride price to the father-in-law.
The killer shall give a gift to the daughter of the dead one.
Whoever gave an oath shall not break it.
Now the word of the oath is heard.
Do not seize the bull of the father-in-law!
The son-in-law shall transport the bride price on the first day.
The brothers-in-law shall divide the barley.
The driver shall not strike the bull at night.
What is given shall be for the daughter-in-law.
The oath shall be a bond for the brothers-in-law.
Say proper words!
The sun sees the oath.
The son-in-law shall place the yoke on the bull.
The bride price of the granddaughter shall be a bull.
Do not cross the lake at night!
Whoever strikes the bull shall give a gift.
The dead one shall lie in the earth.
Whose daughter is the dawn? She is the daughter of the sky.
Who walks in the sky at night? The moon walks.
Who drinks the sea and is not satisfied?
The cloud carries the water, and a hand does not carry it.
A red bird is sitting on the cloud.
Which star is the first?
Whose head is long?
Who sees the fish in the sea? The eagle sees it.
The wolf of the sky swallows the sun.
Who is alive in the water? The fish is alive.
Which day is long? The first day is long.
Who makes the sun disappear? The night makes it disappear.
Which gift is the giver giving? He is giving a word.
Who crossed the sea? The birds crossed it.
Who sits in the heart? Understanding sits in the heart.
The running horse of the sky is the sun.
Whose taste is in the broth? The taste of the butter is in the broth.
Immortal Sky, give us rain-clouds!
The dawn is red in the sky.
May the dawn carry the daylight to us!
The sky gives gifts to the earth.
May the giver of gifts live!
Moon, you are the sun of the night.
The stars are standing in the sky.
Let us give the first barley to the sky!
Sky, the earth heard your might.
The bull's might is in his heart.
The eagle holds up the sky with its wings.
Now the sun has reached the sky.
The red horses carry the sun in the sky.
May the night hide us from the wolves!
Daughter of the sky, come to us!
The year has arrived, and the moon is becoming full.
